name: kicad-claude
description: MCP server that reads, edits and reviews KiCad 10 schematics and boards, with live part sourcing.

mouser_api_key.title: Mouser API key
mouser_api_key.description: Mouser Search API key (https://www.mouser.com/api-hub/). Leave empty to skip Mouser.

tme_app_token.title: TME app token
tme_app_token.description: TME API v2 app token (https://developers.tme.eu). Needs the TME app secret too.

tme_app_secret.title: TME app secret
tme_app_secret.description: TME API v2 app secret, paired with the TME app token.

farnell_api_key.title: Farnell API key
farnell_api_key.description: Farnell / element14 Product Search API key (https://partner.element14.com). Leave empty to skip Farnell.

digikey_client_id.title: DigiKey client ID
digikey_client_id.description: DigiKey OAuth2 client ID (https://developer.digikey.com). Needs the DigiKey client secret too.

digikey_client_secret.title: DigiKey client secret
digikey_client_secret.description: DigiKey OAuth2 client secret, paired with the DigiKey client ID.
